rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for being able to do something or being permitted to do it.

example.english: I am able to finish work early today.
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 ho2 ji5 zou2 di1 sau1 gung1

rows.note: Use this colloquial alternative when stressing that someone can manage a task or that something is allowed.

example.english: Are you able to carry this heavy bag by yourself?
example.traditional: 呢袋咁重，你一個人拎唔拎得？
example.jyutping: ni1 doi6 gam3 zung6 nei5 jat1 go3 jan4 ling1 m4 ling1 dak1

rows.note: Use this for someone who is clever, skilled, or generally capable rather than merely permitted to act.

example.english: He is able to fix computers really well.
example.jyutping: keoi5 zing2 din6 nou5 hou2 lek1
